summary: This medicine can increase your chance of getting infections, so a blood test must be done before starting and you should be watched for infection during treatment and for one to two weeks after stopping [3]. Treatment should not be started if you currently have an active infection [3]. Warnings also note bradyarrhythmia, which is an abnormally slow heartbeat [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a medium score for liver issues and a low score for heart issues [M].
